breakdown.description: In incompressible inviscid flow, Cp at stagnation cannot exceed 1; Cp=1.5 is inconsistent with Bernoulli-based definition.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification removes the incorrect claim of Cp = 1.5 and instead sets up the problem to derive Cp0 from Bernoulli's equation using the correct definitions (p = p0, U = 0 at stagnation, standard Cp definition). This will naturally yield Cp0 = 1, consistent with the ground truth. The erroneous value is not repeated or endorsed.
